cause: On an enter/exit seat with UsableSeatNum0, Execute first cancelled pending requests for that seat/passenger and published Passenger.m_vehicle plus the seat GUID, then returned false before decrement, movement/pet/AI boarding callbacks. Native EventProcessor had already removed the event; false did not delete/requeue it. The request stranded an event and a partially assigned passenger, and could cancel another future request on the same seat despite failing admission itself. Controlled pinned321206b1 reproduces these states; no live retail/client incident is claimed.

Remove only the obsolete late zero-count return; retain successful decrement and primary vehicle/spellclick-flag update in their existing position. No counter refill, seat replacement, force boarding, automatic retry, timer, packet, progression or item grant. No callbacks occur between this preflight counter check and the retained decrement; intervening pending operations/getters only mutate registry/flags or read unit data.
